crossRefs.note: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse…

parallels.note: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse…

translations.web: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.
translations.bsb: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the new piece will pull away from the old, and a worse tear will result.
translations.kjv: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
translations.asv: No man seweth a piece of undressed cloth on an old garment: else that which should fill it up taketh from it, the new from the old, and a worse rent is made.
